_readme: Cost-plus markup for SWAPD -> offer-card sell prices. Markup scales INVERSELY with cost: cheap services get a bigger multiple (>=2x), expensive ones a smaller % but a healthy absolute margin. bands = [max_cost, multiplier] evaluated low->high (first band whose max_cost >= cost wins). sell = max(cost*mult, cost+min_margin), rounded. Put a fixed sell price in 'overrides' (by service_id) to hand-set any card, e.g. "whatsapp_unban": "$800".
_card_titles_note: Specific, accurate names shown on the card (falls back to the service display). Google/YouTube 'removal' is too broad on its own — name the actual thing.
